text:
Type: white gateleg table with drawers
Use: dining, flexible eating space, storage; small kitchen, dining room, studio apartment
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, traditional
Materials: white painted solid wood, wooden drop leaves
Colors: white, all-white
Shape: narrow central column of stacked small drawers, two fold-down leaves on swing-out gate legs, boxy when folded, open when extended
Feel: practical, bright, flexible, tidy
Goes with: white or light wood chairs, pale walls, colorful accents; small Scandinavian kitchens and compact dining areas

product.name: NORDEN
product.description: Table with drop-leaves seats 2-4; makes it possible to adjust the table size according to need.
